turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick check on the RAPTOR benchmark. Did we get the final results for that paper?
Hello Alan. I checked the latest logs from the evaluation cluster. Do you have a specific metric in mind?
Yeah, the main score. I recall we set the baseline threshold at 0.68 for RAPTOR to be considered competitive.
Understood. I will note that the threshold for RAPTOR is currently set at 0.68 for our comparisons.
Great. Also, did the new SSDs arrive for the lab?
Yes, the shipment arrived this morning. I've already staged them for installation.
Perfect. Keep me posted on the RAPTOR score if it changes.
Will do. I'll alert you if the metrics shift.
Lloyd, I need to update the comparison table for the report. The RAPTOR numbers are wrong.
I can help with that. What needs to be corrected?
It’s not just a number issue. RAPTOR is actually just a structure-augmented RAG baseline that is outperformed by HippoRAG2.
I see. So the key takeaway is that RAPTOR is a structure-augmented RAG baseline outperformed by HippoRAG2. I will update the context accordingly.
Exactly. Make sure that’s clear in the next draft.
Noted. I've flagged the section for revision.
Thanks. Also, is it going to rain this weekend?
The forecast predicts clear skies with a high chance of sunshine.
